data_rules: A supplier/network lead, a branch, a sales office and a concrete plant are different entities.
Country market membership is not confirmation of nationwide delivery or product stock.
Preserve unknown prices, pack masses, tax, delivery, handling, ratings, coordinates and stock as null.
A public stock claim is scoped to its product, branch/channel and observation time; never a verified live feed.
Normalize only explicit compatible units. Normalization does not establish grade, application or standard equivalence.
No row currently qualifies as a confirmed cheapest delivered offer.
Keep quote-only discovery results visible when numeric prices or coordinates are absent.
Do not use city/town reference coordinates as shop coordinates.
Preserve seller market and product origin as separate country fields.
Merchant confirmation and user service/quality reviews require a separate supported collection process.
Map layers distinguish retail locations from plants and offices. Nearest is straight-line only until a routing provider is used.
Do not broadcast a price or website stock claim to every branch of its parent network.
Source checked date is not merchant confirmation or a current inventory timestamp.
